payload.description: guest takes nothing. Asked by the fact that first needs the server on a try page (3.4): when nobody is signed in, session makes a guest account and sets the cookie; when an account is already held, it answers with that one.

reply.description: The session once this browser holds a guest account, as session: read answers it; or why no guest was made: not-a-try-page outside a try page (8), unavailable when the server cannot be reached.

oneOf.description: The signed-in user's id or null, and whether a passkey may still be registered (registry has room, MAX_USERS).

guest.description: The account is a guest: no passkey, made on a try page (3.4). False when absent.

admin.description: The account is the admin, the first registered with a passkey (3.4). False when absent, and false while the admin views as someone.

name.description: The account's name as people see it, such as "Guest 14".

viewingAs.description: Only while the admin views as someone (12): the name of the account the browser holds.

startedOverAt.description: When this account last started over, in milliseconds since the epoch, so the page can offer Undo during the undo window after the reload (12).

leaving.description: The browser is about to change account (12): every replicated fact uploads its outbox and then empties its local copy.
